details.name: Perlica
details.quote: I have always believed that you will lead us upon the right path once more. Welcome back to Endfield Industries, Endministrator.
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Team Management: Industrial Science Perlica has the managerial powers and diplomatic resources to coordinate various organizations. She also allocates resources and personnel in a flexible and rational fashion to ensure success in various production activities and joint-ventures.
details.exp2d: Originium Arts: Protocol Enhancement Thanks to Techno-Protocol, her special Arts unit designs are now widely used as they allow low aptitude users to cast Arts normally as well.
details.hb1d: Lifestyle: Extreme Food Taster No dietary preferences and incapable of gaining weight. After meeting Chen Qianyu, Perlica became very interested in "food that she never tried before".
details.hb2d: Creative: Wildlands Speedster She is the light and shadow of the Band, and her bike leaves trails in the snow and sand. However, she has only shared this secret with you.
